newsitem.title: USA: Barnett agrees to acquire Republic Banking.
newsitem.headline: Barnett agrees to acquire Republic Banking.

text.p: Barnett Banks Inc said it has reached an agreement in principle to acquire Republic Banking Corp.
Terms of the proposed deal were not disclosed.

Republic Banking is the holding company for Republic National Bank of Miami, which operates 25 offices primarily in Dade County. Founded in 1965, Republic has total assets of $1.5 billion and deposits of $1.3 billion.
The agreement is subject to the completion of due diligence and the approval by both boards of directors of a definitive acquisition agreement, Barnett said.
